Add team collaborators

## Goal

Give every teammate and your instructor access to this repo. Teammates can't push until they're added, so do this first. The person who created the repo follows these steps.

## Steps

1. Ask each teammate for their GitHub username.
2. On GitHub, go to the main page of this repo.
3. Under the repo name, click **Settings**. If you can't see the tab, open the **...** menu, then click **Settings**.
4. In the **Access** section of the sidebar, click **Collaborators**.
5. Click **Add people**.
6. In the search field, start typing your teammate's name, then click the name in the list of matches.
7. Click **Add NAME to REPOSITORY**.
8. Repeat for each teammate, and for your instructor: `ZakBrinlee`.

Each person gets an email invitation and has access once they accept it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Your instructor, `ZakBrinlee`, has been invited.
- [ ] Every teammate has been invited.
- [ ] Every teammate has accepted the invitation.
- [ ] Every teammate can see this repo and has cloned it.

## Where to look

GitHub Docs: [Inviting collaborators to a personal repository](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/setting-up-and-managing-your-personal-account-on-github/managing-access-to-your-personal-repositories/inviting-collaborators-to-a-personal-repository)
